ana: Heads-up — planning a scheduled GPU pool cycling + egress path test this Sun 04:00-07:00 UTC. Purpose: rebalance capacity across racks, refresh NIC firmware in tiny batches, and validate cross-AZ egress failover. No model changes planned.
infra-bot: Maintenance window created: mnt-2026-03-29-191234 — affected pools: gpu-pool-{eu,us,apac}. Notifying oncall.
sam: Quick Q — will Dedicated customers see brief connection drops or token errors? Any SLA impact?
ana (note): typo in my name above — actual sender is ana.
acha: (typo again) <-- disregard
ana: fixing, ignore previous two typos
ana: sorry for the noise, continuing as ana.
ana: To answer @sam — we expect negligible SLA impact. Routing policy will failover to spare pools in the same region first; canary routing enabled for high-SLA tenants. We'll hold reserved capacity for Dedicated until their sessions drain.
chao: Can we set per-rack maxUnavailable=2 and drain-delay=5m? Also throttle evictions to ~1/node/min to avoid KV cache churn and inference tail latency spikes.
ana: yes to both. Proposed drain controls: 
```
# cordon -> annotate for maintenance -> controlled drain
kubectl annotate node <node> maintenance=planned
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=15m
# autoscaler update
patch cluster autoscaler set maxUnavailablePerRack=2
```

sam: +1. Also request we pause batch-job scheduling to the region during the window (reduce noisy batch/quantization jobs).
chao: I'll add a pre-check to ensure KV cache hit-rate is warmed before each node goes out. If hit-rate < 90% we'll skip that node for now.
tanya: Who owns the pager for post-drain regressions? Also add smoke tests: 1) 2k small prompts to a canary model, check p99 gen latency < 300ms and error rate < 0.5% 2) 1k embedding ops to validate throughput.
nana: ops-oncall will own immediate pages. Infra will do pre/post smoke runs and own runbook execution. I'll update runbook with the exact smoke run commands.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24 hours before window.
sam: We should also double-check cost impact if egress crosses AZs — running a quick calc: moving 2 racks cross-AZ -> ~0.7TB/day egress => est $120/mo. If >$200/mo, prefer same-AZ only.
ana: Good point. I'll run numbers and set a hard limit; if cost > $150/mo we'll skip cross-AZ migration and just rebalance within AZ.
chao: Small note — for Private deployments we need customer opt-in before any control-plane-impacting ops. Add that to runbook.
ana: noted; will flag Private/Dedicated customers and coordinate opt-ins with CS.
ana: Draft schedule: EU pools 04:00-04:50 UTC (racks A-C), US pools 05:10-06:10 UTC (racks D-F), APAC smoke only 06:30-07:00 UTC (no full drains unless warm). We'll start with EU to validate process.
tanya: Looks reasonable. Please include step to validate egress routing by forcing a failover to next-eu-egress and checking external call latency < 50ms increase.
nana: Will add. Action items: 1) ana: post final runbook by EOD Fri with exact node list and opt-ins 2) chao: implement throttle + pre-checks 3) sam: pause batch job schedule during the window 4) tanya: define smoke test harness 5) ops-oncall: be available.
chao: ack :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident channel #incidents will be auto-subscribed for the window.
infra-bot: Final note — rolling windows will limit concurrent drains to 1 rack per region. If telemetry shows latency > 2x baseline we will abort and rollback routing.
nana: thanks all — I'll post the runbook and node roster shortly.
sam: thanks, appreciate the prep.
ops-bot: Reminder created for follow-up postmortem slot next Tue 10:00 UTC.
nana: last msg: please react with :thumbsup: if you reviewed the plan so I can mark the window as green.
chao: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
tanya: :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Window status: pending approvals (3/3 required).
